details_description: On May 19, 2026, Cumilla Polytechnic Institute High Tech Club (CPIHTC) hosted a Marketing & Branding Workshop in collaboration with Latitude Media Creative Agency at the institute's conference room. The event featured presentations on modern marketing strategies, brand identity development, content creation, and visual communication. Students took part in hands-on exercises and group activities, producing sample marketing materials and receiving live feedback from instructors. The workshop aimed to provide practical skills and actionable techniques for building and promoting personal and organizational brands. We thank all organizers, partners, and participants for making the workshop a success.
